categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in precision metal stamping and mold manufacturing, focusing on components for 3C electronics (computers, communications, home appliances), automotive parts, industrial machinery, and medical peripherals. It also engages in jig and automation machine manufacturing, assembly of electrical and mechanical components, and import-export trade. The business segments are diversified with 3C products accounting for 46%, automotive 22%, and industrial equipment and others 32% of revenue.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced precision stamping, plastic injection molding, metal-plastic insert molding, electroplating, laser welding, and automated assembly processes. It integrates CAD/CAM for mold design and CNC machining for manufacturing, complemented by AI-based visual inspection systems and automated production lines. The firm emphasizes vertical integration from mold design to finished product assembly, including proprietary plating and coating technologies to enhance product quality and cost efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include manufacturers of notebook and desktop computers, smartphones, cameras, printers, TVs, audio equipment, 5G network servers, electric shavers, and electronic cigarettes. The company also serves automotive manufacturers requiring connectors, ECU components, and LED lighting parts, as well as industrial equipment producers of relays, circuit breakers, and uninterruptible power supplies. Medical device makers are another important customer segment, particularly for surgical and diagnostic equipment components.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with 16 production sites and 2 offices, including major facilities in Taiwan (headquarters and multiple plants), China (Shanghai, Suzhou, Qingdao, Dongguan, Xiamen, Tianjin, Wuhan), Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia, Mexico, and Japan. Sales are distributed with approximately 70% in Asia excluding Taiwan, 21% in Taiwan, 5% in the Americas, and the remainder in other regions. The global footprint supports localized supply and customer proximity.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream of the supply chain as a precision component and mold manufacturer supplying parts to OEMs in electronics, automotive, industrial machinery, and medical sectors. It integrates upstream mold design and manufacturing with downstream assembly and testing, providing one-stop solutions. The firm is positioned as a key supplier of critical metal and plastic components enabling mass production for its customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding international presence, vertical integration of upstream and downstream processes, and diversifying revenue streams evenly across 3C, automotive, and industrial equipment sectors by 2025. R&D focuses on developing high-precision molds, advanced insert molding, automated assembly machines, and AI-driven quality inspection. The company also invests in TPS lean manufacturing and IoT monitoring to enhance production efficiency and quality. Collaboration with customers on early-stage design and joint development is emphasized.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of precision metal stamped parts, molds, jigs, and assembled components. The company also earns income from contract manufacturing and ODM services by participating in customers' design and development phases. Additional revenue streams include export sales and trading activities related to components and raw materials. There is no indication of subscription or licensing models.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include domestic Taiwanese firms such as Tong Hsieh Electronics, Chang Xin, Jia Ying, Yi Quan, Shun De, Jian Tong, and Jia Zhang. The company is one of the largest and most advanced precision stamping and mold manufacturers in Taiwan, distinguished by its comprehensive technology integration, global production network, and strong R&D capabilities. It competes on quality, technological sophistication, and customer trust rather than price alone.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$6.6 billion in the latest fiscal year, a 15% increase from the prior year, with pre-tax profit rising 57.7%. Net profit attributable to the parent company reached NT$1.06 billion, setting a historical high. Total assets grew 25.65% to NT$12.3 billion, and equity increased 31.77% to NT$8.9 billion. The firm maintains a stable growth trajectory supported by expanding production capacity and diversified markets.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its comprehensive one-stop manufacturing capability integrating mold design, metal stamping, plastic injection, plating, laser welding, and automated assembly. It offers high precision, quality, and production efficiency supported by advanced technologies like AI visual inspection and TPS lean manufacturing. Its global footprint enables close customer collaboration and localized supply, while its strong R&D and technical training systems ensure continuous innovation and skilled workforce. The firm positions itself as a trusted partner delivering reliable, high-quality components across multiple industries.
